items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Gee. [INTERVIEWEE] You drink a glass o' that, boy, and you really lit up like a church house.

ctx.x: It was corn liquor but it had some kind of needle they put down in it, and they mixed somethin' up in it, and you would stir it. You'd stir it till it got red hot, almost boilin'...
You drink a glass o' that, boy, and you really lit up like a church house.
